{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the three channels
print("Channels in data:", sales['channel'].unique())

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
age_sentinel_mask = sales['customer_age'] == -1
print(f"Number of sentinel age values (-1): {age_sentinel_mask.sum()}")

# Check revenue column type and sample
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample of revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(5).tolist())"}
